content: Xammaqqiza Waannisa kiitteez asita
Yesuusa taphpho nam77ii tamaaritayis azaza inggeezaypp guye ezaypp denddii tamaarssodayissinnee sabbakodayis Galila katamitayiko qiteeza.
Waannisa achch kara yezar Kiristtoosa ootheez bazita si7ii, fa tamaaritaypp nam7ita eziko kiittii,
«Ye7oda giinttintteezay nenanee? nu hara naago?» yeegii oyceeza.
Yesuusa unttiko mahii, «yhanigii yi si7izibazinnee yi be7eez baz Waannisas odoytta.
To7itay be7ada, shoollizitay yedhdhoda, boriqonttor hargintteez asitay geezhoda, tullitay si7oda, yhayqqeezittay yhayiqoppi dendoda; manqqitayis Wongilay sabbakinttoda.
Taal dhubinttekazay anjjintteezaya» yeegeeza.
Waannisa tamaaritay guye maaqqii qittin, Yesuusa woyayis Waannisa baz odittar, «Yha liizho gadhayid ab be7adayis kezeene? Carkko eni7isiza maqa be7adayis ye7eenennee?
Yeezin, ab be7adayis kezeenee? Lo77o afila ma77eez as be7adayisonee? Lo77o afila ma77ezitay kaatitay keetha yeza.
Yeezin, ab be7adayis kezeenee? Nabe be7adayisonee? Yeezako, yi nabeppekka aadhizana bi7iza.
yeeginttii xaafintteezay eesii.
Ta yinttis turo odiza; maachchapp yelintteezitay ganccepp Xammaqiza Waannisapp aadhizay oonkka baaya; salo kaatetititha ubbaypp xiqqizay, ezipp aadhoda,
xammaqiza Waannisa wodepp aykkii yhayino hellodayis salo kaatetithay gaame urqqinttiza, miinggii butintteezitay ye aqa geloda.
Nabitay ubbitayinnee Muse higgay Waannisa wode hellodayis hanod baz tinbbite odeeza.
Yikkee, yi u kiita ammanod maaqqiko, ye7od ginttintteez Eelaasa, yeyi E Waannisa.
Yikkee, si7iz hayer yezay si7o.
«Yikkee, yha wode yeletitha abara aaziso? Gabe gancce bettii woli xeegii,
yeegiz na7ita aaziza.
Xammaqiza Waannisa meekazarannee uzhekkazar yi7in, ‹Tuna ayyanar yeza› yi yeegeeza.
As Na7ay miittarannee uzhittar yi7in, ‹Zhimbarannee ushshii zhaare, qaraxe gachchisizitayinnee nagaranchchitay dabbo› yeegeeza. Yikkee, ecetithi tumatithay e oosayir benttiza» yeegeeza.
Ammanaam ixxeez katamito
Yeypp guye, Yesuusa gaame malatita ootheez katamitayid yez asay fa nagarapp maaqqii maaroteth gelaam ixxeez gishos unttan,

«Ayye Koraazinee katamas, ayye Beetesayda katamas, abis giiko, yi gancce oothintteez malatay Xiroosannee Sidoona oothintteez maaqqeezako, u binii budo tizhinttii, kayo afila ma77ii fa nagaraypp maaqqii attoda.
Zin ta yinttis odiza; pirdda gallas yinttapp aathii Xiroosasinnee Sidoonas pirdday kawuzhoda.
Ma yhannee qifirnahooma, ne pude salo kezodayis koyinee? Hanaamii! Neenii Si7oole wodhdhoda. Abis giiko, ne gancce oothintteez malatitay Soodoma oosintteezako Soodome yhayino hellodayis yessadazin.
Zin ta neesi odiza; pirdda gallas neeppi aathii Soodomas pirdday kawuzhoda» yeegii kacceeza.
Kiristtoosar yez shemppo
Ye wode Yesuusa, «adayyo, salonnee sa7a Godayyo, neenii yhaya eranchchitayippennee ecitaypp qosii duude na7itayis qoncciseez gishos nena ta galatiza.
Ee, ta adayyo, yhayi ne lo77o shenay garkk haneeza.
«Ubbay taasi ta Adaypp ingintteeza. Adaypp hara Na7a erizay baaya, Na7ayppennee E unttisi qonccisodayis koyizttaypp hara Ada erodayis danda7izay baaya.
«Yinttano, daabureezitayyo, toofo deexeez ubbitayyo taako yhana ye7oytta; ta yinttan shemppisoda.
Taanii ta wozinar keehannee haayo maaqqeez gishos ta qambarayid geloytta, taapp tamaaroytta; yinttii, yi shemppos shemppo demmada.
Ta qambbaray liiqama, ma ta toofaykka shawuko» yeegeeza.
